headline.zh: 为中小企业客户准备财产险续保方案
headline.en: Prepare property insurance renewal for SME client

scenario.zh: 客户的仓库保单即将到期,需要比较多家承保商报价并更新投保信息
scenario.en: Client's warehouse policy expires soon, need to compare carrier quotes and update coverage details

instruction.zh: FRANK从CRM同步客户基本信息和历史保单
instruction.en: FRANK syncs client basics and policy history from CRM

output.zh: 已关联3年保单记录,上次理赔信息和风险评估已加载
output.en: Linked 3-year policy records, last claim and risk assessment loaded

output.zh: 创建新档案,基础企业信息和资产清单待补充
output.en: New profile created, business basics and asset inventory pending

instruction.zh: 客户仓库扩建,需调整保额和附加条款
instruction.en: Client expanded warehouse, need to adjust coverage amount and riders

output.zh: FRANK提取建筑面积、库存价值和消防设施信息
output.en: FRANK extracted building area, inventory value and fire safety details

output.zh: 保留原有保额,标记为可能承保不足需人工复核
output.en: Original coverage kept, flagged as potential underinsurance for review

instruction.zh: FRANK向4家承保商发送报价请求并整理回复
instruction.en: FRANK sent quote requests to 4 carriers and organized responses

output.zh: 保费较低但免赔额较高,洪水险需单独附加
output.en: Lower premium but higher deductible, flood coverage as separate rider

output.zh: 综合保障含自然灾害,保费适中且续保折扣优厚
output.en: Comprehensive with natural disasters, moderate premium and loyalty discount

instruction.zh: 选择推荐方案,FRANK准备客户沟通文件
instruction.en: Select recommended option, FRANK prepares client communication

output.zh: 建议书草稿已备好,包含保障对比和费率说明,待经纪人审核发送
output.en: Proposal draft ready with coverage comparison and rate explanation for broker review

output.zh: 跟进邮件已起草,询问洪水险捆绑折扣,等待承保商回复
output.en: Follow-up email drafted asking for flood bundle discount, awaiting carrier response

takeaway.zh: FRANK处理报价收集、信息提取和文档准备,经纪人专注客户关系和专业建议
takeaway.en: FRANK handles quote collection, data extraction and document prep while broker focuses on client relationships and expert advice
